intended_object: A proof that the right homotopy relation on edges of a 2-truncated quasicategory is transitive. In Lean it is a `def` only because `HomotopyR f g` is a type of witnesses (a `CompStruct (id x₀) f g`, i.e. a 2-simplex with boundary (id, f, g)), not a `Prop`. This is inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: This definition is the witness-level form of a lemma (transitivity), not a definition of a new mathematical object. Given 2-simplices h₁ : (id, f, g) and h₂ : (id, g, h), it builds a 2-simplex (id, f, h). It does this with the inner-horn filling `assoc` of the 2-truncated quasicategory, applied to `idCompId` and the two hypotheses. This is the standard proof that right homotopy is transitive. The library then uses it, through `Nonempty`, to show that the propositional relation `HomotopicR` is an equivalence relation. Which witness gets chosen is an implementation detail with no counterpart in the literature. The statement it encodes is correct.
